questions.text: How old is Aizhan Bekova?
questions.hint: "I am 18 years old" — first paragraph.

questions.text: What is the name of Aizhan's group?
questions.hint: "My group is called Group 101."

questions.text: Aizhan is from Almaty.
questions.hint: Aizhan is from Aktobe, not Almaty.

questions.text: How many students are in Group 101?
questions.hint: "There are 20 students in our group."

questions.text: Ms. Aigerim is from ___.
questions.hint: "She is from Almaty." — paragraph 3.

questions.text: Where is Dias Serik from?
questions.hint: "Dias is from Shymkent, in southern Kazakhstan."

questions.text: Dias wants to become a software engineer.
questions.hint: "His dream is to become a software engineer."

questions.text: What time do classes start at WKU?
questions.hint: "Classes start at 8:30 am every day."

questions.text: What does Dias say about the WKU library?
questions.hint: "The library is absolutely huge!" — Dias.

questions.text: Dias's roommate is from Almaty.
questions.hint: Bekzat is from Kyzylorda, not Almaty.

questions.text: What is Aizhan's roommate Zarina?
questions.hint: "Her name is Zarina. She's a dancer!"

questions.text: Dias says he is a ___ person (he doesn't mind early classes).
questions.hint: "I'm a morning person!" — Dias.

questions.text: Aizhan ends the call because she is tired.
questions.hint: "It's dinner time in the dormitory." — Aizhan.

questions.text: What does Dias say he really likes at WKU?
questions.hint: "I also really like Computer Science."

questions.text: Choose the correct form: I ___ a first-year student.
questions.hint: I → am. Only "am" is used with I.

questions.text: Choose the correct form: She ___ from Almaty.
questions.hint: He / She / It → is.

questions.text: We ___ classmates in Group 101.
questions.hint: We / You / They → are.

questions.text: "They is students" is correct English.
questions.hint: They → are. Correct: "They are students."

questions.text: Which is the correct negative form: I am not →
questions.hint: Never I amn't! Correct: I'm not.

questions.text: Choose the correct article: She is ___ English teacher.
questions.hint: "English" starts with vowel sound → an.

questions.text: "She is a university student" uses the correct article.
questions.hint: "University" sounds like [j]uːnɪvɜːsɪti — consonant sound → a, not an.

questions.text: Choose the correct article: ___ sun rises in the east.
questions.hint: Only one sun → the. Unique things take "the".

questions.text: What does "motivated" mean?
questions.hint: "Motivated" = enthusiastic and determined to achieve something.

questions.text: The area of land with all university buildings is called a ___.
questions.hint: Campus = the area of land with all university buildings.

questions.text: What is a "dormitory"?
questions.hint: Dormitory = a building where students live on campus.

questions.text: "Hardworking" means a person who never studies.
questions.hint: Hardworking = always putting a lot of effort into work.

questions.text: What does "opportunity" mean?
opts: A chance to do something positive
questions.correct: A chance to do something positive
questions.hint: Opportunity = a chance to do something positive and valuable.

questions.text: One of the two main periods of the academic year is called a ___.
questions.hint: Semester = one of the two main periods of the academic year.

questions.text: What does "fluently" mean when talking about language?
questions.hint: Fluently = speaking a language smoothly and naturally.

questions.text: To "graduate" from university means to...
questions.hint: Graduate = finish a university course and receive your degree.
